claims.sentence: To apply for dissertation defense support, graduates must submit a personal application to the University Director
Graduates must deliver this application to the department responsible for organizing the educational process for graduate programs
Graduates must submit the application no later than 30 calendar days after passing final certification
The university has the right to provide graduates with support when they submit their dissertation for defense
The support is formalized by an order from the University Director or an authorized person
The support lasts for a period of not more than one calendar year after graduates complete their graduate program
The evidence does not specify the exact content or format of the support provided
The evidence does not state the procedure for the department to process the application or for the director to issue the order
The evidence does not define the consequences of submitting the application after the 30 calendar day deadline
The evidence does not clarify whether the one calendar year period begins on the date the program is completed or on the date the order is issued
The evidence does not list eligibility requirements, fees, or conditions for terminating the support early
